A Histogram that can be fed iteratively.

class activations.torch.utils.histogram.NeuronsHistogram(bin_size=None, device='cpu')[source]

Bases: object

A collection of multiple Hisograms that can be fed iteratively.

Args:

Desired size of bins. If omitted will be computed on first batch.

Device to use. Bin widths and bin counts are stored on device and computations are performed on device.

Variables:

If True bin width is computed when NeuronsHistogram.fill_n() is called.

bin_size (float):

Width of bins.

Left edges of bins. Element at index \(i\) belongs to ith histogram.

fill_n(input, ax_idx=0)[source]

Adds batch of inputs to histograms.

Args:
input (torch.Tensor):

Inputs to add. If of shape \((A, N, B, C, ...),\,\text{where }N\text{represents number of histograms}\) will be reshaped to \((N, A*B*C*...)\).

ax_idx (int):

Index of dimension in input that matches number of histograms.
